skill.name: executor-discovery
skill.description: Clarify approved initiatives, gather evidence, and compare viable approaches before a human approves the next phase.
skill.summary: Guide evidence-based discovery and record a human-approved approach without implementing production code.
skill.author: atri10

security_audit.summary: Of 130 static findings, 129 concern Markdown syntax, fixed relative references, or legitimate workflow operations. One confirmed risk concerns binding the visual server to all interfaces, exposing token-protected HTTP beyond localhost. No evidence found of prompt injection or deliberate exfiltration; referenced scripts are absent from the reviewed files, so their implementations remain unverified.

remediation.issue: The remote-access example binds the visual server to all network interfaces over HTTP.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer loopback with authenticated port forwarding. Require explicit consent for non-loopback binding, restrict reachable interfaces, and protect remote connections with TLS.

content.value_statement: Unclear requirements and unsupported assumptions make technical decisions difficult. This skill guides structured discovery, evidence gathering, and approach comparisons before human approval.
actual_capabilities: Review repository context and clarify purpose, constraints, success criteria, and exclusions through one question per message.
Distinguish independent initiatives from multiple specifications within one initiative.
Structure research documents with measured, cited, inferred, or unverified evidence and explicit knowledge gaps.
Compare two or three defensible approaches using identical evaluation axes, reversal costs, and recommendation-changing conditions.
Record the human choice in options documents, initiative indexes, and phase logs using the companion Executor workflow.
Guide optional browser mockups and selection feedback after explicit consent, using synthetic data and companion server scripts.
limitations: Requires an approved initiative charter and the broader Executor workflow.
Referenced scripts, templates, and safety contracts are not included in these two skill files.
Does not implement production code, scaffold projects, install dependencies, or choose an approach on the human behalf.
Visual sessions require companion server tooling; non-loopback binding exposes the service beyond localhost.

use_cases.title: Resolve an Unclear Feature Request
use_cases.description: Clarify an approved feature initiative, define exclusions, and compare realistic approaches before requesting stakeholder approval.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a Technical Approach
use_cases.description: Gather evidence for a migration or performance decision and compare alternatives with explicit uncertainty and reversal costs.

use_cases.title: Compare Interface Concepts
use_cases.description: Use consent-based visual mockups with synthetic content to compare layouts and connect feedback to the discovery decision.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify an Initiative
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the approved charter for [initiative]. Summarize repository facts, then ask one question about unresolved purpose, constraints, or success criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start discovery without implementing code.

prompt_templates.title: Check Scope Boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess [initiative] for independent deliverables. Explain whether it needs separate initiatives or multiple specifications, and ask one question about any unresolved boundary.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: clarify a request spanning several subsystems.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence-Based Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: For [initiative], document unsupported claims with evidence labels. Compare two or three approaches using identical axes, reversal costs, and recommendation-changing conditions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare research and options documents for a human decision.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Visual Decision Record
prompt_templates.prompt: For [initiative], check consent before proposing visual comparisons. Use synthetic data, preserve terminal feedback as primary, and reconcile the session decision with the options document.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: connect an optional visual session to the approval record.

output_examples.input: Compare approaches for an approved tenant-placement initiative with an unresolved scalability claim.
output: Research separates cited scalability claims from measurements and lists the missing benchmark.
Two approaches are compared on effort, operational risk, migration cost, and reversibility.
The recommendation states the tenant threshold that would change it and awaits the human choice.

output_examples.input: A request includes billing changes and an independently shipped reporting service.
output: Scope review identifies independent deliverables and recommends separate initiatives with a declared dependency.
Initiative creation is handed to the intake workflow instead of scaffolding folders during discovery.
Detailed discovery continues on the first initiative after the split is agreed.

output_examples.input: Compare dashboard layouts after the user accepts the visual companion.
output: The visual session shows synthetic examples and records layout selections.
Terminal feedback remains the primary decision input.
The final layout choice is recorded in the options document before advancing.

best_practices: Read the approved charter and repository evidence before asking questions.
Label every claim honestly and state what evidence would change the recommendation.
Use synthetic mockup data, keep credentials outside tracked artifacts, and prefer loopback connections for visual sessions.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation before the human approves an approach.
Calling cited claims measured or omitting evidence gaps.
Putting real customer data or credentials in tracked visual artifacts.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it after charter approval when scope, requirements, or the right approach remains unclear.

faq.question: Does this skill write production code?
faq.answer: No. It produces discovery records and comparisons; measurement probes must be documented as throwaway evidence.

faq.question: What documents does discovery produce?
faq.answer: It produces RSCH research documents when evidence is needed and OPTS options documents for decisions with alternatives.

faq.question: Who chooses the final approach?
faq.answer: The human chooses. The skill records that choice and updates the discovery phase before handing off to architecture.

faq.question: Are browser mockups required?
faq.answer: No. The visual companion is optional, offered for genuinely visual questions, and requires explicit consent.

faq.question: Can the visual companion run remotely?
faq.answer: The guide shows non-loopback binding, which increases exposure. Prefer authenticated forwarding and encrypted connections; never display real customer data or credentials.
